jonah: Quick sync on prefill+handoff plan. goal: avoid double-ownership and keep p99 tail stable during shard transfers. proposing small staged dry-runs, then production canary with automated aborts.

mei: sounds good. propose we add a prefill checksum: after prefill, compute hash(prefix set) and compare against source to ensure no misses.

sophia: also add a brief prefilling rate-limit per tenant to avoid hotkey storms. Prefill rate = min(1000 qps, 0.05 * tenant_qps).

jonah: nice. gate signals: p99_handoff_latency < 100ms, p95_token_latency delta < 5ms, prefix_duplicate_count == 0, prefill_checksum_match == true for 5m.

mei: for duplicate detection use: `sum(rate(prefix_claims_total[1m])) by (prefix) > 1` alert -> Sev2. we'll run a background reconciler for 1m post-handoff to autocorrect transient dupes.

infra-bot: suggested command: `/kv-transfer --shard 42 --dry-run --prefill --verify-checksum --health p99_handoff_latency,prefix_duplicate_count --window 5m`

sophia: rollback semantics: mark shard read-only on target, resume reads on source, revoke new claims, and run background eviction on target to flush any half-filled prefixes. make rollback idempotent.

jonah: we'll also capture trace ids for each handoff step (`handoff:start`, `prefill:complete`, `verify:checksum`, `handoff:commit`, `handoff:rollback`) and store them under canary artifacts.

mei: test plan: staging dry-run with synthetic hotkeys, chaos injection (10% packet loss) and a rollback exercise. require green before prod canary.

sophia: operational knobs: immediate abort on any increase in lease_conflict_rate by >50% or eviction_requeue > 5/min, and a soft-throttle if prefix_staleness_count rises > 3x baseline.

jonah: action items: mei -> implement checksum probe & reconciler; sophia -> add throttles and rollback runner; infra-bot -> implement dry-run flag and artifact upload.

infra-bot: ack. uploading artifacts to `s3://redwood-canaries/kv-transfer/1738470001/` and will emit event `kv_transfer.dryrun` to trace.

jonah: scheduling tentative canary Fri 14:00 UTC. we'll keep notes here and converge on final playbook tomorrow. ping me for questions.
